g.text: Estimate a mechanism, then simulate from a new initial state
Fixed illustrative test: first source and first trial. Right: 10 new trajectories per source per seed.
All methods receive the same test initial position and velocity. Forecasts use no future observations or true future states.
Single trajectory at left; aggregate results at right. Selective integration does not improve every held-out trajectory.
